newsitem.title: USA: America First unit to merge with Bay View.
newsitem.headline: America First unit to merge with Bay View.

text.p: America First Financial Fund 1987-A Limited Partnership said Thursday it has definitively agreed to merge its subsidiary, America First Eureka Holdings, with Bay View Capital Corp.
Terms call for the partnership to get $90 million cash and $210 million in Bay View common stock for America First Eureka Holdings, which owns EurekaBank FSB.

America First said no definite estimate is yet available, but it expects about $250 million of the $300 million in cash and stock to be received to be paid to unitholders. It said this equals about $41.50 per unit.
The deal is to be tax-free to the unitholders, it said.
America First said closing is expected either December 31 or January 1, 1998, and is subject approval of its unitholders.

America First Eureka Holdings is headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its wholly owned subsidiary, EurekaBank, is a $2.2 billion asset federal savings bank located in Foster City, California, with 36 branches in the San Francisco Area.
